title: Companion Screens: The New Era of Sports Consumption
summary: What fans really do on their second companion screens during the game and how they want ads personalized to them and the moment.
body_markdown:
The companion screen has become part of the game itself. 84% of U.S. adults use another device while watching live sports, and for weekly viewers that number climbs even higher. It’s an active environment for communication, discovery and shopping — not simply just for distraction.


This report unpacks that behavior in detail and shows where brands have room to get more relevant, both to the fan and to what’s happening on the field.
